name: aniverse
description: AniVerse local anime discovery and streaming web application.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server && node scripts/build-static-host.mjs
scripts.start:online: npm run migrate:postgres && npm run start
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e --workspace client && npm run test:e2e:online --workspace client
